findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: enrol_alert_relay, get_data_dignity_standard, get_verified_business_facts · Private data: check_exposed_services, check_ollama_hardening, disable_alert_relay, enrol_alert_relay, get_hardening_guide, get_verified_business_facts, inventory_ai_agents, rotate_alert_relay · Public sink: check_exposed_services, check_ollama_hardening, check_ollama_loopback, enrol_alert_relay, inventory_ai_agents · Destructive: check_ollama_hardening, list_packs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: enrol_alert_relay, get_data_dignity_standard, get_verified_business_facts · Private data: check_exposed_services, check_ollama_hardening, disable_alert_relay, enrol_alert_relay, get_hardening_guide, get_verified_business_facts, inventory_ai_agents, rotate_alert_relay · Public sink: check_exposed_services, check_ollama_hardening, check_ollama_loopback, enrol_alert_relay, inventory_ai_agents · Destructive: check_ollama_hardening, list_packs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
